name: Text Fitter
description: Text Fitter is a Dify tool plugin that trims text so that it fits within an LLM's context window. It picks the most important sentences out of the input with extractive summarization and returns them unchanged -- it never rewrites or paraphrases the text. Supports Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese and English, and runs locally with no API key and no network calls.
